entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: An ancient Kor ruin on the Na Plateau in Murasa on Zendikar, whose eerie harmonic resonance drives visitors mad; it was destroyed in Nissa's burst of energy.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which the Singing City stands, healing after the confrontation there.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: The region of Zendikar containing the Na Plateau and the Singing City.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who travels to the Singing City to seize the Lithoform Core, and ends up empty-handed.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Companion who traveled with Jace to the Singing City.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker and lithomancer who seeks to use the Lithoform Core to stabilize Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker and guardian of Zendikar who opposes Nahiri and destroys the Singing City using the Core's power.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental companion, the elemental manifestation of Zendikar.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A powerful artifact, a piece of Zendikar created to undo damage, capable of rewriting the nature of Zendikar.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: The people who built the ruin of the Singing City.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region of Zendikar that began to regrow at a magically accelerated rate after the explosion.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane to which Jace intended to take the Core for study.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient beings of Zendikar; the Singing City is believed to predate their rise.

events.summary: Jace and Akiri travel to the Singing City seeking Nahiri and the Lithoform Core; Jace escapes the maddening music with a sound-blocking spell.
events.quote: Jace Beleren and Akiri traveled to the city in search of Nahiri

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya confront Nahiri and Jace; Nissa destroys the leyline focal point, halting Nahiri's plan to activate the Core.
events.quote: A battle ensued that culminated in Nissa destroying the leyline focal point

events.summary: Nissa confronts the fleeing Jace and Nahiri at the city's threshold and demands they leave the plane.
events.quote: She demanded they leave the plane, reaffirming her role as its guardian.

events.summary: Jace infiltrates the city, traps Nahiri's mind with a psychic illusion and seizes the Core, but Ashaya takes it and gives it to Nissa.
events.quote: he trapped her mind with a psychic illusion and seized the Core

events.summary: The Core tells Nissa telepathically that it is a piece of Zendikar created to undo damage.
events.quote: revealing that it was a piece of Zendikar and was created to undo damage

events.summary: Jace tries to seize control of Nissa's mind and Ashaya restrains him; Nissa merges the Core's power with her own as Nahiri attacks.
events.quote: Nissa tapped into the Core's power and merged it with her own, unleashing a powerful burst of energy.

events.summary: The explosion destroys the Singing City; Zendikar begins visibly healing and Nissa discards the Core and departs.
events.quote: The explosion destroyed the Singing City

events.summary: Nahiri blames Jace and planeswalks away; Jace is left remorseful, hoping redemption is possible.
events.quote: Nahiri, angry and bitter, blamed him and planeswalked away.

relations.note: Nissa opposes Nahiri's plan to use the Core.
relations.quote: an act opposed by Nissa Revane
Nissa and her elemental companion Ashaya confronted Nahiri and Jace
located on the Na Plateau in Murasa
an ancient and mysterious Kor ruin

relations.note: Jace trapped Nahiri's mind and seized the Core; she blamed him afterwards.
relations.quote: Nahiri, angry and bitter, blamed him and planeswalked away.
